brief: Holds a list of hash lists, such as the rows of a small record set, and wraps or prints them.
detail: Build one with new stzListOfHashLists(aList) or StzListOfHashListsQ(aList); it is a stzList, so every list method is available, and init refuses anything but a list of hash lists or an empty list. ToListOfStzHashLists wraps each row in a stzHashList to ask its keys and values, and Show prints the rows. ToSetOfHashLists is meant to remove repeated rows and does not today.
